verses.geez: መኑ፡ የአምኖሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ ወመኑ፡ የአምር፡ ፈክሮ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ጥበቡ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ያበርህ፡ ገጾ፡ ወዘአልቦ፡ ኀፍረት፡ ውስተ፡ ገጹ፡ ይጸላእ።
verses.translation: A man's wisdom will lighten his countenance; but a man of shameless countenance will be hated.

translations.lxx: A man's wisdom will lighten his countenance; but a man of shameless countenance will be hated.
translations.kjv: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
translations.ron: Cine este ca înţeleptul şi cine poate să ştie ca el tâlcuirea lucrurilor? Înţelepciunea unui om îi luminează fata şi asprimea felei lui i se schimbă.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ አፈ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ወለቃለ፡ መሐላ፡ ኢትጐጒዕ።
verses.translation: Observe the commandment of the king, and that because of the word of the oath of God.

translations.lxx: Observe the commandment of the king, and that because of the word of the oath of God.
translations.kjv: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
translations.ron: Ascultă de porunca regelui din pricina jurământului făcut lui Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ኅልፍ፡ ወኢትቁም፡ በነገር፡ እኩይ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘፈቀደ፡ ይገብር።
verses.translation: Be not hasty; thou shalt go forth out of his presence: stand not in an evil matter; for he will do whatsoever he shall please,

translations.lxx: Be not hasty; thou shalt go forth out of his presence: stand not in an evil matter; for he will do whatsoever he shall please,
translations.kjv: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
translations.ron: Nu te grăbi să te depărtezi de fata lui. Nu stărui în lucrul cel rău, că ceea ce voieşte face.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ሥሉጠ፡ ይትናገር፡ ወመኑ፡ ይብሎ፡ ምንተ፡ ገበርከ።
verses.translation: even as a king having power: and who will say to him, What doest thou?

translations.lxx: even as a king having power: and who will say to him, What doest thou?
translations.kjv: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
translations.ron: Cuvântul regelui este hotărâtor şi cine poate să-i spună: "Ce faci?"

verses.geez: ዘየዓቅብ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ ኢየአምር፡ ቃለ፡ እኩየ፡ ወጊዜሁ፡ ለፍትሕ፡ የአምር፡ ልበ፡ ጠቢብ።
verses.translation: He that keeps the commandment shall not know an evil thing: and the heart of the wise knows the time of judgment.

translations.lxx: He that keeps the commandment shall not know an evil thing: and the heart of the wise knows the time of judgment.
translations.kjv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.
translations.ron: Celui ce ascultă porunca nu i se va întâmpla nimic rău, că inima unui om înţelept va cunoaşte timpul şi judecata.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ቦ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወፍትሕ፡ እስመ፡ አእምሮቱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ላዕሌሁ።
verses.translation: For to every thing there is time and judgment; for the knowledge of a man is great to him.

translations.lxx: For to every thing there is time and judgment; for the knowledge of a man is great to him.
translations.kjv: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
translations.ron: Pentru orice lucru este un timp şi o judecată; că mare este nenorocirea care apasă asupra omului,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘየአምር፡ ምንተ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ወዘይከውንሂ፡ መኑ፡ ይነግር።
verses.translation: For there is no one that knows what is going to be: for who shall tell him how it shall be?

translations.lxx: For there is no one that knows what is going to be: for who shall tell him how it shall be?
translations.kjv: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
translations.ron: De vreme ce el nu poate să ştie mai dinainte ceea ce se va întâmpla. Oare, cine îi va da de ştire ceea ce va fi cu el?

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይሤለጥ፡ በመንፈሱ፡ ለከሊአ፡ መንፈስ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሤለጥ፡ በዕለተ፡ ሞት፡ ወአልቦ፡ መልእክት፡ በዕለተ፡ ቀትል፡ ወኢታድኅን፡ ረሲዓነ፡ ዘኀቤሃ።
verses.translation: There is no man that has power over the spirit to retain the spirit; and there is no power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in the day of battle; neither shall ungodliness save her votary.

translations.lxx: There is no man that has power over the spirit to retain the spirit; and there is no power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in the day of battle; neither shall ungodliness save her votary.
translations.kjv: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
translations.ron: Omul nu este stăpân pe duhul său de viaţă, ca să-l poată opri; la fel nu este stăpân pe ziua morţii şi în această luptă nu încape amânare. Nelegiuirea nu va scăpa pe cel care o săvârşeşte.

verses.geez: ኵሎ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ወወሀብኩ፡ ልብየ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘፍጥረት፡ ዘተፈጥረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ዘመጠነ፡ ተሠልጠ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለአእክዮተ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: So I saw all this, and I applied my heart to every work that has been done under the sun; all the things wherein man has power over man to afflict him.

translations.lxx: So I saw all this, and I applied my heart to every work that has been done under the sun; all the things wherein man has power over man to afflict him.
translations.kjv: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
translations.ron: Am văzut toate aceste lucruri şi mi-am sârguit inima mea spre tot lucrul care se face sub soare într-o vreme când omul stăpâneşte pe altul spre nenorocirea lui.

verses.geez: አሜሃ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ረሲዓነ፡ ውስተ፡ መቃብር፡ ቅዱስ፡ እንዘ፡ ይበውኡ፡ ወዘእምቅዱሳን፡ ሖሩ፡ ወተወደሱ፡ በውስተ፡ ሀገር፡ እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ገብሩ፡ ዝኒ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: And then I saw the ungodly carried into the tombs, and that out of the holy place: and they departed, and were praised in the city, because they had done thus: this also is vanity.

translations.lxx: And then I saw the ungodly carried into the tombs, and that out of the holy place: and they departed, and were praised in the city, because they had done thus: this also is vanity.
translations.kjv: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
translations.ron: Şi am văzut păcătoşi în mare cinste purtaţi la locul de odihnă, pe când cei ce lucraseră drept au fost izgoniţi de la locul cel sfânt şi au fost uitaţi în cetate. Şi aceasta este deşertăciune!

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ቅስት፡ እምእለ፡ ገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡ በፍጡን፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አዕረፈ፡ ልበ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ቦሙ፡ ለገቢረ፡ እከይ፡ ዘአበሰ፡ ወገብረ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ እምትካት፡ ወእምቅድሜሁ።
verses.translation: Because there is no contradiction made on the part of those who do evil quickly, therefore the heart of the children of men is fully determined in them to do evil.

translations.lxx: Because there is no contradiction made on the part of those who do evil quickly, therefore the heart of the children of men is fully determined in them to do evil.
translations.kjv: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
translations.ron: Din pricină că hotărârea pentru pedepsirea răutăţii nu este îndeplinită de îndată, pentru aceasta se umple de răutate inima oamenilor ca să facă rău.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አአምር፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ ቦ፡ ሠናይት፡ ለእለ፡ ይፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ይፍርሁ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ።
verses.translation: He that has sinned has done evil from that time, and long from beforehand: nevertheless I know, that it is well with them that fear God, that they may fear before him:

translations.lxx: He that has sinned has done evil from that time, and long from beforehand: nevertheless I know, that it is well with them that fear God, that they may fear before him:
translations.kjv: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
translations.ron: Dar deşi păcătosul face rău de o sută de ori şi îşi lungeşte zilele, eu ştiu că fericirea este a acelora care se tem de Dumnezeu şi se sfiesc în faţa Lui.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ሠናይት፡ ለረሲዕ፡ ወኢነውኅ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጽላሎቱ፡ ዘኢይፈርህ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: but it shall not be well with the ungodly, and he shall not prolong his days, which are as a shadow; forasmuch as he fears not before God.

translations.lxx: but it shall not be well with the ungodly, and he shall not prolong his days, which are as a shadow; forasmuch as he fears not before God.
translations.kjv: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
translations.ron: Fericirea nu va fi pentru cel fără de lege, care, asemenea umbrei, nu-şi va lungi viaţa, fiindcă el nu se teme de Domnul.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ ከንቱ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እስመቦ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ዘይበጽሕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ወቦ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ዘይበጽሕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወእቤ፡ ዝኒ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there are righteous persons to whom it happens according to the doing of the ungodly; and there are ungodly men, to whom it happens according to the doing of the just: I said, This is also vanity.

translations.lxx: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there are righteous persons to whom it happens according to the doing of the ungodly; and there are ungodly men, to whom it happens according to the doing of the just: I said, This is also vanity.
translations.kjv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
translations.ron: Este încă o nepotrivire care se petrece pe pământ, adică: sunt drepţi cărora li se răsplăteşte ca după faptele celor nelegiuiţi şi sunt păcătoşi cărora li se răsplăteşte ca după faptele celor drepţi. Am zis că şi aceasta este încă o deşertăciune!

verses.geez: ወወደስክዋ፡ አነ፡ ለኵላ፡ ፍግዕ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ሠናይ፡ ለሰብእ፡ እምታኅተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዘበልዐ፡ ወሰትየ፡ ወተፈሥሐ፡ ወውእቱሰ፡ ዘሎቱ፡ እምፃማሁ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሕይወቱ፡ ዘወሀቦ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምታሕተ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: Then I praised mirth, because there is no good for a man under the sun, but to eat, and drink, and be merry: and this shall attend him in his labour all the days of his life, which God has given him under the sun.

translations.lxx: Then I praised mirth, because there is no good for a man under the sun, but to eat, and drink, and be merry: and this shall attend him in his labour all the days of his life, which God has given him under the sun.
translations.kjv: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
translations.ron: Şi am ridicat în slăvi veselia, căci nu este nimic mai bun pentru om sub soare, decât să mănânce, să bea şi să se veselească. Numai de l-ar întovărăşi la lucrul lui în tot timpul vieţii pe care Dumnezeu i-o dă sub soare!

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ወሀብኩ፡ ልብየ፡ ለአእምሮ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወከመ፡ እርአይ፡ ሥራኀ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ በመዓልትኒ፡ ወበሌሊትኒ፡ ንዋም፡ ውስተ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ዘይሬኢ፡ አልቦ።
verses.translation: Whereupon I set my heart to know wisdom, and to perceive the trouble that was wrought upon the earth: for there is that neither by day nor night sees sleep with his eyes.

translations.lxx: Whereupon I set my heart to know wisdom, and to perceive the trouble that was wrought upon the earth: for there is that neither by day nor night sees sleep with his eyes.
translations.kjv: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
translations.ron: Când mi-am îndreptat inima ca să cunosc înţelepciunea şi să pătrund care este menirea omului pe pământ, căci nici zi, nici noapte ochii lui nu văd somnul,

verses.geez: ወርኢኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይክል፡ ሰብእ፡ ረኪበ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ መትሕተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ እመ፡ ሚ፡ መጠነ፡ ይቤ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምር፡ ኢይክል፡ ሰብእ፡ ረኪበ፡ ወእመሚ፡ መጠነ፡ ኃሠሠ፡ ኢይክል፡ ሰብእ፡ ረኪበ።
verses.translation: And I beheld all the works of God, that a man shall not be able to discover the work which is wrought under the sun; whatsoever things a man shall endeavour to seek, however a man may labour to seek it, yet he shall not find it; yea, how much soever a wise man may speak of knowing it, he shall not be able to find it: for I applied all this to my heart, and my heart has seen all this.

translations.lxx: And I beheld all the works of God, that a man shall not be able to discover the work which is wrought under the sun; whatsoever things a man shall endeavour to seek, however a man may labour to seek it, yet he shall not find it; yea, how much soever a wise man may speak of knowing it, he shall not be able to find it: for I applied all this to my heart, and my heart has seen all this.
translations.kjv: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
translations.ron: Atunci mi-am dat seama, privind lucrarea lui Dumnezeu, că omul nu poate să înţeleagă toate câte se fac sub soare, dar se osteneşte căutându-le, fără să le dea de rost; iar dacă înţeleptul crede că le cunoaşte, el nu poate să le pătrundă.
